title: Gaussian-Splat-Lite documented constraints validator
purpose: Reusable Python module and test suite encoding the arithmetic constraints documented in Gaussian-Splat-Lite's API pages (art_01M6CXXT85NWH4F1W8NYD08JCQ r1). Covers SplatCapture resolution cap, RAD SH codebook entry limits, maxStdDev acceptable range, and lod-base spacing bounds. Nothing is run against the library itself; these are documentation-derived validators.
attribution: Source: WilliamLiu-1997/Gaussian-Splat-Lite documentation at commit b85bcca0, summarised in art_01M6CXXT85NWH4F1W8NYD08JCQ r1. Library licensed Apache-2.0.
execution: See separate execution receipts; publication alone is not a passed test.
